_comment: a.js and main.js form an import cycle. Loading main.js runs a.js before main.js and b.js, so the calls to `local` and `reexported` throw, and they must stay. The entry list starts with a.js, so the global order runs b.js first. A function declaration is initialized before any code runs, so the call to `hoisted` should be eliminated. `strictExecutionOrder` keeps the import order of each module. Without it, the output runs b.js before a.js.
